item.title: v1.3.9 beta
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b3837
  • Added support for llama 3.2, 3.1, RWKV, MiniCPM(2.5, 2.6, 3), Chameleon models
  • llama.cpp updated to b3837
  • Added support for llama 3.2, 3.1, RWKV, MiniCPM(2.5, 2.6, 3), Chameleon models
  • Added Metal support for Mamba
  • Added Llama 3.2 download links (working with LLaMa3 Instruct template)
  • Added Phi 3.5 download links (working with Phi 3 template)
  • Added Bunny template and download link
  • Some metal improvements
  • Fixed some errors for gemma2, DeepSeek-V2, ChatGLM4, llama 3.1, T5, TriLMs, BitNet models
  • Fixed some other errors

item.title: v1.3.4
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b3445
  • Added Gemma2, T5, JAIS, Bitnet support, GLM(3,4), Mistral Nemo
  • Added OpenELM support

  • Added the ability to change the styling of chat messages.

  • Added a built-in demo chat for new users. (The ChatML template is used)

  • Some detokenizer fixes

  • LoRa and FineTune are temporarily disabled due to the need for code refactoring due to a large number of errors

item.title: v1.3.0
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b3190
  • Added support for DeepseekV2, GPTNeoX (Pythia and others)
  • Added support for Markdown formatting
  • Added support for using history in Shortcuts
  • Added Flash Attention support
  • Added NPredict option
  • Metal and CPU inference improvements
  • Sampling and eval improvements
  • Some fixes for phi-3 and MiniCPM
  • Fixed some errors
  • Added Qwen template

item.title: v1.2.5
item.content:encoded:
• Save/Load context state. Now it is possible to continue the dialog with the model even after the program is reopened. Read more here.
  • Chat settings such as sampling are now applied without reloading the chat.
  • Skip tokens option. Allows you to specify tokens that will not be displayed in the results. May be useful for phi3 and qwen.
  • Fixed some errors.

item.title: v1.2.0
item.content:encoded:
• Added shortcuts support
  • llama.cpp updated to b2864
  • Added llama3 instruct template
  • Some llama-3, Command-R fixes
  • Fixed a bug that could cause the application to crash if the system prompt format is incorrect
  • Fix memory bug in grammar parser
  • Fixed some other bugs

item.title: v1.1.1
item.content:encoded:
• Added Gemma template and download link
  • Added warning about creating a chat without a selected model
  • Fixed some bugs

item.title: v1.1.0
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b2717
  • Phi3, Mamba(CPU only), gemma, StarCoder2, GritLM, Command-R, MobileVLM_V2, qwen2moe models
  • IQ1_S, IQ2_S, IQ2_M, IQ3_S, IQ4_NL, IQ4_XS quntization support
  • Performance improvements
  • Fixed crash when EOS option is on
  • Fixed image orientation

item.title: v1.0.1
item.content:encoded:
• Fixed some bugs that could cause the application to crash
  • Added the ability to hide the keyboard, to do this tap anywhere in the chat window

  • When you clear the message history, the model context is also cleared

  • Added ability to temporarily disable chat autoscrolling by tapping anywhere in the chat window, autoscrolling will be enabled automatically when sending a new message

  • *If you are getting "strange" prediction results in version 1.0.1, but everything was fine in version 1.0.0, try disabling the BOS option in the template.

item.title: v1.0.0
item.content:encoded:
• Added support for multimodal models MobileVLM, Yi-VL, LLaVA, Obsidian (tested on mobileVLM 3B)
  • Fixed crash on switch model
  • Fixed a bug that could cause a crash on startup of feintune
  • Some UI improvements
  • Fixed some other errors

item.title: v0.9.5
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b2135
  • Added the ability to download models from the application menu
  • Added progress indicator for model loading
  • Fixed disappearing keyboard bug
  • Fixed some other bugs

item.title: v0.9.2
item.content:encoded:
• Added possibility to specify System Prompt, which will be added to the text of the first message in the session. See FAQ.
  • Added ability to clone chat (without message history)
  • Chats are sorted by last modification date
  • Clear chat history button is placed on the toolbox.
  • You can now use both {prompt} and {{prompt}} designations in templates
  • Fixed a bug with displaying already deleted chats and models
  • Fixed some other bugs
  • Templates have been updated

item.title: v0.9.0
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b1891
  • added support for Phi2, TinyLlama and other models
  • various GUI improvements
  • added clear chat button
  • user templates improve
  • fixed token to string issue
  • fixed gpt2 metal
  • fixed many other errors

item.title: v0.8.0
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b1601
  • added support for StableLM-3b-4e1t models
  • added support for Qwen models
  • added the possibility to merge LoRA with the model
  • added merge and train LoRA progress bar
  • added the possibility to save user templates
  • added multyline input
  • fixed many other errors

item.title: v0.7.5
item.content:encoded:
• added LoRA train support experimental
  • add BOS/EOS token to begin/end of prompt options
  • handle special tokens options
  • model loading indication
  • token/sec indicator on message
  • fixed some errors

** Due to high RAM consumption LoRA training on iPhone is possible only on Pro models It is recommended to use q8_0 quantization for LoRA training.

item.title: v0.7.0
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b1396
  • LoRA adapters support (More about LoRA here)
  • added support for MPT and Bloom models
  • added support Metal for q5_0, q5_1 quantization
  • gpt-2 now with Metal support
  • added special token support for prompt template like User: {{prompt}}
  • fixed tokenizer bug that could cause application crashing
  • fixed mirostat for non llama
  • fixed premature completion of predictions
  • fixed many other errors

item.title: v0.6.2
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b1256
  • rwkv updated to 8db73b1
  • add grammar sampling for llama models, you can put .gbnf files to the grammars directory
  • gpt-2 updated
  • rwkv_eval_sequence 20% increase speed
  • handle GGML_ASSERT
  • starcoder (santacoder) with Metal and mmap support (GGUF)
  • infinite text generation by reseting n_past
  • new llama2 and saiga template
  • fixed some errors
  • fixed mmap always false
  • fixed many errors
  • fix crash on n_tokens > context size
  • fix llama mlock
  • fix crash on n_tokens > context size
  • fix llama mlock

item.title: v0.5.2
item.content:encoded:
• llama.cpp updated to b1132, GGUF format support and increase in the speed. The old file format is still supported but uses llama dadbed9.
  • Added Falcon models support (only GGUF)
  • Added mmap and mlock options
  • Added template for RWKV-4
  • Added prompt format text editor with multiline support
  • Added tfs_z and typical_p sampling parameters
  • UI Improvements
  • Templates improvments
  • Fix model rename
  • Fixed some UI bugs that could cause the app to crash.
  • Fix llama, replit token_to_str
  • Fixed many errors on model loading.
  • Fixed scrolling issue
